flows.name: Discover, review, and learn
steps: Queue non-duplicate candidates for administrator review
Publish or archive with structured feedback
Use accumulated outcomes in subsequent ranking and policy evaluation
flows.expectedOutcome: Discovery improves from auditable administrator decisions without bypassing human publication approval

claims.description: The live database supports atomic candidates, structured feedback, duplicate prevention, and reversible policies
Stale review, concurrent duplicate, and unexpected run failure paths fail loudly
Focused backend and frontend regression suites pass
Independent functional and standards reviewers approve the implementation
The frontend, backend, and scheduled discovery owner expose the published contracts
Authenticated desktop and mobile screenshots prove the structured review and learning interfaces
